dataList.flavor:
To Jeanne, the department store was the world she could perceive most comfortably.

She was given the office chair of Le Kaki's Giant, a role that was supposed to remain neutral. But as you can see for yourself... She wanted to bloom in все those brilliant colors больше чем anybody else. She wanted to burn with passion, Meur, to stand on that стадии и dance with you.

It's unfortunate that she couldn't let herself do so. There were too many gazes to mind, too many expectations to satisfy... until they wound themselves around her like chains. She couldn't blossom vibrantly as she wanted. Even the budding wish had to be hidden away.

I can't make Jeanne's nausea disappear, but I can give her the chance to be herself, to bloom as herself without worrying about anyone's gaze in this world she was thrown в. Perhaps, если she's deep in that passion, she'll get to forget the nausea for a little while.

And... I don't think Jeanne is the only one who needs that. Everyone in the City does. They might refuse, but I do believe that everyone deserves the same chance.

dataList.name: Pouvoirs de la vie
dataList.desc:
Если an ally becomes Staggered due to урона, использует скилл "Le Manque-à-être" on the said ally (один раз за ход)

Если an ally is defeated, призывает a Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God, у которого есть 3 [BuffetRevival] при the на следующий ход Start
dataList.flavor:
The violence на which things are brought в being. The God of the Rouges possesses the authority of birth.

Where does consciousness go когда we die? And before we are born, from where does it emerge?

To send it back to that place, или to tear it forth from there... both are workings of the same violent power.

Если Этот юнит не имеет [BuffetRouge] и is при 10+ счётчика [ChargeRouge], Тратит 10 счётчика [ChargeRouge] при использовании скилла для получения Сила монет +2
dataList.flavor:
There are conditions to tasting the pleasures of life, и as it is with все things conditional, this carnal pleasure is fated to fail.

The stipulated limits и end have deemed it so.

- 2+: Финальная сила скилла +1
- 3+: Скиллы наносят на +1 больше силы [Laceration:*Кетчупа*]
- 4+: Skill Сила монет +1
- 5+: Do not теряет стаки [BuffetRouge] на себе

The destined и inevitable desire of those who live, those who are birthed.
A curselike need, its inescapability threaded на fate.
